test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following statements are correct?

(a) For a lens the first principal focus is the position of the object whose image is at infinity

(b) For a lens the first principal focus is the position of the object whose image is formed at twice the focal length.

(c) For a lens the second principal focus is the position of the real image whose object is at infinity

(d) For a lens the second principal focus is the position of the object whose image is formed at twice the focal length
solution:
The correct answer is __**1**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****Principal Focus of a Lens:**

 
• The **first principal focus** of a lens is the point on the principal axis where light rays parallel to the principal axis converge (in case of a convex lens) or appear to diverge from (in case of a concave lens)
